caption: Day 4. One in twelve, at the Cross.
prompt: FULL-PAGE COLOUR INSERT ILLUSTRATION for a light novel, portrait orientation, edge-to-edge composition with a strong focal point and cinematic depth; opaque, fully painted background. A crowded winter market square at a stone crossroads in a poor clay-and-river town, low grey sky, breath-steam everywhere: two hundred people in drab wool and sheepskin, pigs in a pen, stalls of pots and eels and barley loaves, clay dust in the air, a squat bell on a timber frame (not a church), a weathered notice-board with a nailed notice (illegible marks only). On a raised wooden platform sits BERR CLAY the Thane (see reference: heavy, grey stubble, red wool cord across his chest), reading from a clean slate; beside him a thin assessor in grey. The crowd leans in to hear. In the right foreground, seen from just behind her shoulder, SELLA VAIL (see reference) stands with a willow basket on her hip and grey wool over the baby's face, her door-shaped burn visible on the hand gripping the basket. The infant's eye shows through a gap in the wool, watching the slate.
